notes.title: Update 1.0.0.2-What's done?
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33783902/5a9ec8bc0ac7ceb2c8a5fea7564a7fffb0bd9eaa.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33783902/bca7de08528b72e141c40246f8905b606f6fd6c7.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]Update 1.0.0.2:Ai and portals fix,game mode changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Ai fix-Now,bots have more realistic movement.They are on the watch for you for each corner of the maze.Be careful!
[*]Portals work as they should-now they can't teleport you twice to the same teleport point  
[/list]
[b]What with game mod?[/b]
So,we changed game mode a little bit,and now it's "Infinite death match".Fight with bots(sooner,with players),and stand as long as you can.

Now,we trying open multiplayer game as soon as we can.
